description: Find physicist profiles in INSPIRE-HEP by name, INSPIRE BAI, ORCID, INSPIRE ID, or author recid. Each profile carries its recid, BAI, ORCID, current and past positions, advisors, arXiv categories, links, awards, and a literatureQuery that selects the person's papers in cern_inspire_search_literature. A name returns ranked candidates (a bare surname can match tens of thousands of profiles, and a less-cited namesake can rank first), so confirm the person from positions and categories before passing a bai or recid to cern_inspire_get_citation_summary. An identifier matches exactly.

query.description: A physicist's name ("Witten, Edward" or "Edward Witten") or one identifier: INSPIRE BAI (Edward.Witten.1, exact and case-sensitive), ORCID (0000-0002-7752-6073 or an orcid.org URL), INSPIRE ID (INSPIRE-00136372), or author recid.

name: cern_inspire_search_authors

authors.description: Matching profiles, in INSPIRE relevance order.

degreeType.description: Degree supervised (e.g. phd, master), when recorded.

recid.description: Advisor author record ID, when linked.

endDate.description: End date (YYYY or YYYY-MM), when recorded.

institution.description: Institution name as INSPIRE records it.

institutionRecid.description: INSPIRE institution record ID, when the position links one; pass affid:N, N being this ID, as the query of cern_inspire_search_literature or cern_inspire_get_citation_summary for the institution's papers.

rank.description: Rank or role (e.g. SENIOR, PHD, POSTDOC), when recorded.

startDate.description: Start date (YYYY or YYYY-MM), when recorded.

inspireId.description: INSPIRE ID (INSPIRE- plus 8 digits), when recorded.

literatureQuery.description: Literature query selecting this person's papers; pass to cern_inspire_search_literature.

name.description: Name as INSPIRE records it, "Last, First".

orcid.description: ORCID iD, when the profile links one.

otherIds.description: Identifiers beyond BAI, ORCID, and INSPIRE ID.

endDate.description: End date (YYYY or YYYY-MM), when recorded.

institution.description: Institution name as INSPIRE records it.

institutionRecid.description: INSPIRE institution record ID, when the position links one; pass affid:N, N being this ID, as the query of cern_inspire_search_literature or cern_inspire_get_citation_summary for the institution's papers.

rank.description: Rank or role (e.g. SENIOR, PHD, POSTDOC), when recorded.

startDate.description: Start date (YYYY or YYYY-MM), when recorded.

recid.description: INSPIRE author record ID; pass to cern_inspire_get_citation_summary.

status.description: Career status INSPIRE records (e.g. active, retired).

stub.description: True when the profile is an unclaimed stub generated from paper metadata.

description.description: Label INSPIRE gives the URL, when any.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: INSPIRE answered 400 to a parameter value it refuses. `inspire_rate_limited`: INSPIRE returned 429 after the pacer and retries. `pacer_shed`: The server's outbound INSPIRE queue could not start the request within the call's remaining budget. `upstream_unreadable`: The INSPIRE body exceeded the byte ceiling, was HTML where JSON was expected, or was invalid JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matchedAs.description: How the query was read: orcid, inspire_id, bai, or recid (exact identifier match), or name (free-text search).

notice.description: Guidance on an empty or capped result.

totalCount.description: Total author profiles the query matched.

truncated.description: True when more profiles matched than were returned.

title: Search INSPIRE authors
